title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin closed the US session at $64,734, up 1.2% amid persistent fear with the index at 28. The network showed strength with hashrate holding 1,036 EH/s and a packed mempool of 89,476 transactions clearing at just 1 sat/vB. 

Daily range stayed tight around current levels with no major breakout. Key takeaway: price resilience despite sentiment weakness signals accumulation pressure rather than capitulation. 

Watch overnight for any mempool clearance spikes or hashrate fluctuations into the nex
